name: get_perf_stats
purpose: One read-only call returning numeric frame-health: FPS, per-thread ms, draw calls, object counts, GC recency, process memory.
engineApi: GRenderThreadTime et al. (RenderTimer.h:107-126); GAverageFPS/GAverageMS (UnrealEngine.cpp:633-635, local extern); GNumDrawCallsRHI (RHIStats.h:66-67); GUObjectArray (UObjectArray.h:1269); FPlatformMemory::GetStats (GenericPlatformMemory.h:330)
cooked: works — globals independent of asset form
hazards: Thread timings go STALE (not zero) when no viewport draws (editor minimized) — needs staleness caveat
GNumDrawCallsRHI is last-completed-frame data (one-frame lag, verified RHI.cpp:1368-1369)
GAverageFPS/GAverageMS have no public-header declaration — must re-extern locally (fork fragility)

name: log_tail
purpose: Incremental structured tail of the editor process log via a GLog ring-buffer device with monotonic sequence ids; poll sinceSeq.
cooked: works — log lines independent of asset form
prevents: run_console_captured misses async output (its own comment, MifBridgePIE.cpp:457-458)
hazards: Device removal MUST precede module unload or GLog serializes into freed code
GLog serializes from any thread — device must override both thread virtuals and lock in Serialize

name: message_log_read
purpose: Structured read of editor Message Log listings (MapCheck, PIE, BlueprintLog, ...) — where map_check and PIE warnings actually land.
cooked: works — messages are runtime editor state, read unaffected
hazards: GetLogListing silently CREATES missing listings (MessageLogModule.h:52) — must gate on IsRegisteredLogListing

name: screenshot_request
purpose: Capture what is actually on the editor screen — active viewport incl. PIE frame and Slate UI — as a file; distinct from capture_camera.
cooked: works — captures the framebuffer; asset form irrelevant
hazards: FScreenshotRequest is global static state — single-flight required, concurrent requests race on Filename
Request consumed only when a viewport draws — minimized editor stalls it (adviceIfStuck)
SetResolution can also return false on oversize — surface its bool as accepted too

name: list_automation_tests
purpose: Enumerate every registered automation test with flags and source locations — prerequisite for running any of them.
cooked: works — tests are code, not assets
hazards: loadTestModules:true can stall the game thread while modules load — explicit opt-in only

name: run_automation_test
purpose: Run one automation test in-process and get pass/fail, error entries, and duration as numbers via request+poll with a latent-command pump.
cooked: works for code tests; tests saving cooked content fail inside the test
hazards: StartTestByName silently refuses under GIsSlowTask||GIsPlayInEditorWorld — must check GIsAutomationTesting after
StopTest asserts check(GIsAutomationTesting) — calling after refused start or twice CRASHES the editor
PIE exclusivity: refuse when PIE is running; functional tests manage their own PIE session
StartTestByName silently kills an in-flight test — single-flight refusal required

name: trace_start
purpose: Record an Unreal Insights .utrace of an agent-triggered workload (channel-selectable); trace_stop/trace_status companions.
cooked: works — tracing instruments code, not assets
hazards: Trace can be compiled out (UE_TRACE_ENABLED) — Start returns false; surface, don't hide
Start is a no-op if a connection is already active (TraceAuxiliary.h:75-76) — error naming trace_stop

name: get_properties_bulk
purpose: Read up to 200 object/property pairs in one call — the watch-list primitive for PIE observation loops, without undo pollution.
engineApi: ResolveGenericTarget (MifBridgeNodes6.cpp:23), ResolveReadPropertyPath (MifBridgeNodes6.cpp:58), FProperty::ExportText_Direct — existing plugin helpers, no new engine API
cooked: works — same as get_property; stripped editor-only data simply absent
prevents: Reads routed through batch push empty undo entries per poll (H_batch FScopedTransaction, MifBridgeNodes.cpp:1269)

name: pie_resolve_path
purpose: Convert an editor object path to its live PIE counterpart (and back) deterministically, with optional existence verification.
cooked: works — pure string mapping plus in-memory find

name: world_state_hash
purpose: One deterministic CRC summarizing world state (actor set + quantized transforms + loaded levels) — the reproducibility primitive.
cooked: works — actor transforms and level names exist regardless of asset form
hazards: Actor iteration order unstable across runs — must sort by path; float noise killed by pinned quantization
